_readme: THE MASTER SUBSCRIPTION-RENEWAL FLOW — authored once, provisioned per shop by
deploy/seed/bootstrap-subscription-renewal-flow.sh via notification-service's
POST /internal/whatsapp/flows/provision (clone_flow_id XOR flow_json; this file is the
flow_json source, sent exactly once, on the platform's own WABA).
DYNAMIC (data_exchange), served by platform v0.19.12's LoyaltyEngine(name=
"subscription_renewal") — the SAME generic redeem-a-thing engine loyalty-points redemption
uses (services/notification-service/app/core/loyalty_flow.py), reusing booking's SELECT/
CONFIRM/SUCCESS screen shapes (core/booking_flow.py's constants) rather than a new engine.
See services/operations/app/adapters/renewal_provider.py for what answers each screen: one
shop's own due renewal invoice, seeded as the Flow's `customer` id at send time.
SCREEN FLOW: SELECT ("جدّد الآن" — the one option is the whole due invoice, priced) ->
CONFIRM ("تأكيد") -> the endpoint's `redeem` creates the real pay-link and terminates via
extension_message_response (reward_ref = pay_url) — SUCCESS below is the schema-mandated
terminal screen and Footer, shown only as a fallback (see loyalty_flow.py's own SUCCESS
reply, which almost never lets this screen actually render).
KEY NAMES ARE THE ENGINE'S CONTRACT, not ours to rename here: `selection` (SELECTION_FIELD),
the SELECT/CONFIRM screen ids, and `reward_ref`/`flow_token` on the terminal params — renaming
any of them here without renaming them in loyalty_flow.py breaks the redeem step silently.
SCHEMA VERIFIED AGAINST: developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/flows/reference/flowjson and
developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/flows/reference/components (fetched 2026-09-08, same
pass that verified booking's own generator, core/flow_json.py). version 7.3 / data_api_version
3.0 — the same pinned pair booking's generator uses; keep them in step if that ever changes.
